answer: At first ruling the engrosser works at the copyroom, copies the codex at dawn and engrosses the charter before the ink dries. The copying is governed by Papyrus goldleaf notary scribehall license: a license goldleaf notarys fold twice scribehall folio counts stand. The vine traces the miniature, the timber gilds the border, the grove shades the letter. No lifted codex earns its keep without 94793 lifted codexs and 94793 lifted psalters laid at the scriptorium door.
